data.source_title: Introduction to medical equipment inventory management
data.locator: Executive summary; inventory updates at receipt, retirement and annual audits; related consumable, spare-part and test-equipment inventories; risk-based inclusion
data.source_n: Not applicable; equipment-management guidance, not a local asset census or utilization study.
data.source_evidence_basis: WHO states that equipment inventory should be continually updated, including on receipt, retirement and annual audit, and considered alongside consumables, spare parts and testing/safety tools; inclusion/detail should be risk-based.
data.limitations: Sources establish general health-technology-management and infection-prevention requirements, not a particular hospital inventory, vendor model, staffing plan, utilization rate, maintenance interval, or service-time distribution. Family-specific asset presence and all local values remain unknown.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Represent inventory reconciliation and links to consumables, spare parts, and service/testing resources. Do not infer quantities, stock levels, or asset counts.
